rowPages.text: The directory in each new theme

brief.text: Four themes on one token set. Light is today's site, unchanged. Dark is its calm twin. Golden Hour and Darkroom are the playful pair: retro film stock, SF golden hour, a 70s stripe, sprocket holes and a camera date stamp. Only colours, fonts and a few flourish tokens change; the layout never does.

sample.text: Project names and tracks are real records. Vote counts, comments, accounts and track counts are sample data, as on the other mockup boards.
